subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the experimental Claws series own a durable Gateway cron lifecycle in core now, including the persisted scheduler-ownership and removal-recovery contract introduced by this slice?
rationale: The branch is technically focused but establishes a new cross-owner product contract across the Gateway scheduler, Claw provenance, export, and deletion; tests cannot choose whether that permanent boundary belongs in the current experimental series.

options.title: Sponsor the cron lifecycle slice
options.body: Confirm this Gateway-owned ownership model as part of the experimental Claws roadmap, then require real-Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the boundary
options.body: Keep Claws without cron mutation until the RFC or a smaller owner-approved contract defines the durable scheduler and removal semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the cron lifecycle slice
recommendation.body: Confirm this Gateway-owned ownership model as part of the experimental Claws roadmap, then require real-Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is assigned and has already reviewed the precise lifecycle and ownership boundary at issue.
